description: This file defines a Chroma vector store class for managing vector-based document storage, including methods for adding, deleting, and searching vectors, as well as creating instances from texts or existing collections.

classes.name: Chroma
classes.description: A class extending VectorStore that manages a Chroma vector database, supporting document addition, deletion, and similarity search.

methods.name: addDocuments
methods.description: Converts documents to vectors and adds them to the Chroma database.

methods.name: ensureCollection
methods.description: Ensures that the collection exists in the database, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: addVectors
methods.description: Adds vectors to the database, associating them with documents.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes documents from the database by IDs or filter.

methods.name: similaritySearchVectorWithScore
methods.description: Performs a similarity search with a query vector, returning documents with scores.

methods.name: fromTexts
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an array of text strings.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an array of Document objects.

methods.name: fromExistingCollection
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an existing collection.
